comments.author: pettereng
comments.body: BREAKING CHANGE: adding this field will crash every old client that does exhaustive matching on the response shape. We cannot ship a wire break in a minor release!

comments.author: elinestrom
comments.body: Verified the field is optional and additive — old clients ignore unknown fields, and the compatibility suite pins that with a mixed-version test (run 5240, green). Additive, not breaking; nothing to change.
